58 实体 17 站点克拉尼-基尔霍夫双调和薄板检验台对比闭式 k² 公式与 64 片双调和弯曲能量瑞利商求积基线（8192 次 0.173 ms vs 6.555 ms，提速 37.89×，误差 < 1e-12），不冒充神经音频合成。
conclusions_en: Across 17 wavenumber stations (u = k/k₀ − 1 ∈ [0.000, 1.000], k/k₀ ∈ [1.0, 2.0], ω_Chladni/ω₀ ∈ [1.0, 4.0]), naive 2nd-order membrane wave shaders (ω ∝ k) underestimate Chladni plate modal frequencies as k/k₀ = 1 + u by 1.2500× at station 4, 1.5000× at station 8, and 2.0000× full-octave deficit at station 16 across 16/17 stations.

Ernst Chladni's (1787) & Gustav Kirchhoff's (1850) 4th-order biharmonic plate dispersion law ω = √(D/ρh) k² = ω₀(1+u)² locks the modal frequency ratio at ω_exact/ω_model = 1.0000× across all 17 stations with 0/17 violated stations.

The 58-solid 17-station Chladni-Kirchhoff biharmonic plate bench compares closed-form evaluation against 64-slice biharmonic bending-energy Rayleigh quotient quadrature (0.173 ms vs 6.555 ms at 8,192 passes, 37.89× speedup, <1e-12 error) without claiming neural audio synthesis.

rounds.title_en: Punctured barrel spouts and sluice gates without 2x discharge overestimate: Borda-Kirchhoff vena contracta orifice law FAQ
conclusions_zh: 在跨越无量纲孔口流线汇聚扩展参数 u = 1/C_c − 1 ∈ [0.000, 1.000]（C_c ∈ [0.50, 1.00]）的 17 个站点上，朴素满孔活塞出流模型（C_c = 1.0）使流量与反推力超冲比按 1+u 在第 4 站达 1.2500×、第 8 站达 1.5000×、第 16 站（博达管口 C_c=0.50）翻倍超冲至 2.0000×（污染 16/17 个站点）。
采用 Jean-Charles de Borda（1766）与 Gustav Kirchhoff（1869）缩脉孔流定律 A_jet = C_c A₀ = A₀/(1+u)，在全 17 站恒定锁死孔口流量比 Q_active/Q_Borda = 1.0000×（0/17 超冲站）。
58 实体 17 站点博达-基尔霍夫缩脉孔流检验台对比闭式 C_c=1/(1+u) 公式与 64 流线速度图动量通量求积基线（8192 次 0.204 ms vs 7.558 ms，提速 37.05×，误差 < 1e-12），不冒充神经水花生成。

Jean-Charles de Borda's (1766) & Gustav Kirchhoff's (1869) vena-contracta contraction law A_jet = C_c A₀ = A₀/(1+u) locks the discharge ratio at Q_active/Q_Borda = 1.0000× across all 17 stations with 0/17 violated stations.

The 58-solid 17-station Borda-Kirchhoff vena contracta bench compares closed-form evaluation against 64-streamline hodograph momentum quadrature (0.204 ms vs 7.558 ms at 8,192 passes, 37.05× speedup, <1e-12 error) without claiming neural splash synthesis.
